We are shaping what comes next. Elapsed 00:00 Remaining time unknown − --:-- 0.25 × 0.5 × 0.75 × 1 × 1.25 × 1.5 × 1.75 × 2 × A new species of product tool Software development is at an inflection point. Artificial intelligence is fundamentally reshaping how products are built. AI increases what teams can create, but it also raises the bar for clarity and coordination. At Linear, we are building the tools for this new era of product development. A purpose-built system where teams and agents operate together in a shared, structured environment. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the tool of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Meet the team behind Linear We are designers and engineers. Problem solvers and storytellers. We are a diverse team of individuals, all makers at heart. Will you help us make it better? Open roles ↓ Elapsed 00:00 Remaining time unknown − --:-- 0.25 × 0.5 × 0.75 × 1 × 1.25 × 1.5 × 1.75 × 2 × On a quest for quality We believe that there is a lost art of building software. A craftsmanship that yields products of an exceptional, almost magical, quality. It’s difficult to describe this quality with words and impossible to measure it in numbers, but you can feel it when it’s there. You know it when you experience it. To bring back this level of quality, we are building a tool that empowers product teams to do their best work. A tool with unparalleled speed, focus, and design. Building this tool requires a team of talented individuals who care deeply about the quality of their work, no matter if it’s engineering, design, or customer support. We are looking for people who share our passion for software craftsmanship and getting even the smallest details right. If that sounds like you, please reach out and join us on our quest. ›_ README A conversation on quality Karri Saarinen → Building the sync engine Tuomas Artman → Inside design at Linear Designer Fund → At home with Karri Saarinen Indie → Move fast with little process The Pragmatic Engineer → A conversation on quality Karri Saarinen Building the sync engine Tuomas Artman Inside design at Linear Designer Fund At home with Karri Saarinen Indie Move fast with little process The Pragmatic Engineer How we think and work Linear’s mission is to inspire and accelerate builders. To turn that ambition into reality, we operate based on a set of core principles that keep us focused. 01 . Ship early Simplify and ship smaller. 02 . Build with users Listen carefully and understand their problems. 03 . Know what good looks like Find and create good things. Know what needs to change to make it better. 04 . Think in principles Not in playbooks. 05 . Build things that last Put care into the foundation. Don’t make it a future person’s problem. 06 . Avoid side quests Don’t fix every problem. Avoid adding unnecessary process or documents. 07 . Say it as it is Get to the point and assume good intentions. 08 . Keep the team small, do more with less We build better with fewer people. Wear multiple hats. 09 . Hire the best people The best people hire the best people. Help recruit. 10 . Create fans Build a community of people who use, love, and defend the product. 11 . Fully remote The freedom to work remotely allows for more meaningful work. pub.careersText: Careers - Change How Businesses Run | Ramp Products Partners Solutions Resources Customers Pricing Sign in See a demo Get started Back We only hire builders We only hire builders Come here to solve hard problems, build without permission, and ship work you’re proud of. Sounds intense? It is. See open positions Eashan I. Onboarded 950 new customers in January Sabrina N. Launched our first International market Anne K. Produced our first Super Bowl ad in under a week Nilu K. Built an offer coach that upped accept rate by 10% Anthony H. Broke the record for GitHub commits in Jan Veeral P. Wrote the code that killed expense reports Taylor F. Allocated spend that drove $1B+ in pipeline David O. Manages $55M in marketing spend at age 23 Alexander S. Built an AI spreadsheet editor in two weekends Kendall T. Locked "Brian in a box" with 600,000 receipts Andrew C. Shipped GBP currency with one single PR Paola N. Turned card payable bills into millions in cashback Parth G. Built agents that power our entire GTM team Olivia G. Built the debugging agent that saves our developers sanity Amy Z. Cleared 50+ products for launch last year Alexandra G. Created our first ever user conference Jacob D. Built the GTM brain used in every sales call Jake F. Closed our first Fortune 500 customer Junho C. Built an AI agent that applied for its own credit card Yash W. Deployed agents that run their own lead-gen Jen Z. Rewrote this careers page in one weekend Work on hard problems with hardcore people. Our two founders, Eric and Karim, thought it’d be a good idea to write a letter persuading you not to apply. When we started hiring for Ramp we had one simple criterion: “If this person started a company would we join them?” This made our first call easy. We persuaded Calvin to join as founding engineer. At 11, he was fluent in Python. At 15, his code was running on the International Space Station. That first year, we hired 60 more brilliant misfits. And that group of misfits built the fastest-growing company in New York City. Fast forward to year seven. And we’re growing 10x faster than the median publicly traded SaaS company. We didn’t get here by hiring “normal” people. You’ll be given too much responsibility. You’ll never be bored. You’ll be pushed to do the best work of your career — at the fastest pace of your career. That’s not for most people. And that’s okay. But maybe you’re not “most people.” Not a “normal” startup job. Ready to do the best work of your career? We’ll give you the autonomy and ridiculously talented co-workers to make it happen. What is Ramp? We ’ re the all-in-one AI finance platform, designed around one simple principle: “ If it doesn ’ t save you time or money, we don ’ t build it. ” The result? 70,000 + companies — from family farms to Shopify — saving billions of dollars and hours each year. What’s the culture like? “ Hands off ” doesn ’ t exist at Ramp. Our marketers are coding. Our PMs are rewriting copy. Our devs are building their own agent . We ’ re a proud meritocracy. Titles and roles are the least interesting thing about Ramp employees. And last but not least: Pizza Fridays are tradition. Dinner is every night of the week. Why choose Ramp? Well, we ’ re growing 10x faster than the median publicly traded SaaS company. But that ’ s not why you should choose Ramp. Working at Ramp is a bet on yourself. Name another tech company that locks Brian Baumgartner in a box with 600,000 receipts — or builds its own coding agent. If you have talent and drive we will back you like the Medici family backed Michelangelo. Does Ramp offer benefits? Yes, lots and lots. A competitive salary. Equity. Medical, dental, and vision insurance. One Medical Membership. 401(k) including an employer match. Flexible PTO. Parental leave. Monthly wellness stipend. WFH stipend. Transit benefits. Our platform helps every developer diagnose, fix, and optimize the performance of their code. With Sentry, developers around the world save time, energy, and probably a few therapy sessions. Sentry supports more than 100 coding languages, which means it probably supports yours. We also integrate with a whole bunch of useful tools (and a few necessary evils), including but definitely not limited to GitHub, Slack, and Jira. Numbers That Make Us Look Good Loved by millions of developers and 200K organizations across 146 countries spanning 6 continents with 190B+ events processed daily (We're still waiting on our first customer in Antarctica) and $217M raised in 6 rounds of funding (That's enough to build the Golden Gate Bridge six times, if we could take that money and time travel back to 1933) The Humans Behind the Code The team behind Sentry built and shipped the software behind many fine brands, a short sampling of which will no doubt impress and delight you. We were occasionally useful at Dropbox. Drew pictures at GitHub. Nodded sagely during meetings at Atlassian. Sentry started out as an open-source project. Our founders' goal was straightforward: solve their own problems with an easy way to fix their own mistakes. Ten years later, their two person passion project is the world's leading error-tracking platform with 200+ employees in four offices worldwide. pub.careersText: Careers | Supabase Skip to content Product Developers Solutions Pricing Docs Blog 111.1K Sign in Start your project Open main menu Supabase Careers We're on a mission to build the best developer platform Explore remote opportunities and join our team to help us achieve it. Open positions ( 48 ) 350+ team members in 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken $1B raised 540,000+ community members 40,000+ memes posted (and counting) We work together, wherever we are Working in a globally distributed team is rewarding but has its challenges. We are across many different timezones, so we use tools like Notion, Slack, and Discord to stay connected to our team, and our community. We deeply believe in the efficacy of collaborative open source What is Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. Supabase adds auth, realtime, storage, restful APIs, and edge Supabase was born-remote. Having a globally distributed, open source company is our secret weapon to hiring top-tier talent. Human powered As a completely remote and asynchronous team, we focus on these five traits to keep our team effective: Egoless Mission driven, work for the good of colleagues. Kaizen Mindset Iterative approach, continuously improve all functions. Truth Seeking Intellectually honest, act with integrity, recognize biases. Batteries Included High ownership, intrinsically motivated, care about quality. Undeniable So good you earn respect, reliable, consistently deliver. 1,500+ Contributors building Supabase We're building a community of communities, bringing together developers from many different backgrounds, as well as new developers looking to get involved with open source. We love celebrating everyone who contributes their time to the Supabase mission. Great people deserve great benefits Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a co-working membership that you can use anywhere in the world. Tech Allowance Use this budget for any technology you need for your work setup. Health Benefits We provide 100% health coverage for employees and 80% for dependants. It's important to us that you & your family have health care covered. Annual Off-Sites We believe in the value of in-person time, so we all come together annually for a week. Each year we pick somewhere different in the world. It's a highlight of the year! Flexible Work Work remotely from anywhere in the world. We work in teams, but we work asynchronously. You know what you need to do and when it needs to be done. Professional Development An annual allowance to spend on professional development and education. Use this for courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your continuous learning. Open positions Want to build the best developer platform? We’d love to talk to you.
